about_short_description.short_description: Render provides a unified cloud for developers and teams to host all their applications, databases, and websites.

product.name: Render Platform
product.description: A unified cloud platform for deploying and operating applications, websites, APIs, databases, background processes, and AI agents from connected source repositories.

product.name: Render Web Services
product.description: Managed application hosting for continuously running web applications, APIs, and services, with automated builds, deployments, networking, and scaling.

product.name: Render Postgres
product.description: A fully managed PostgreSQL database service with backups, point-in-time recovery, read replicas, high availability options, and private connectivity.

product.name: Render Static Sites
product.description: Managed hosting for static websites and frontend assets, with repository-based deployments, global CDN edge caching, custom domains, and managed TLS.

product.name: Render Background Workers
product.description: Managed long-running worker processes for asynchronous jobs, queue consumers, data processing, scheduled tasks, and other non-HTTP workloads.

product.name: Render Workflows
product.description: A code-defined orchestration service for durable, long-running workflows with execution management, retries, and scalable background processing.
